_comment: Clip edits for hfw clips. Times are SOURCE seconds of the capture (W/capture/<capture>/timeline.json). Segments at 20-50x are cuts (shorter than one frame). After a new capture, re-pick these with hfw sheet, rebuild, then update the composition times from the printed clip times.

jenkins_run._why: act 1 browser body 964x520 from a 1280x690 capture; 14.4 s from 0.6 s. Cuts: build start-up (blank stages page), redirect to the console after approval, final reload. Stages run at 3x (badge), everything else 1x.

gha_run._why: act 4 browser body 1216x450 (2432x900 at 4K) from 3200x1208 frames, cut at 2432 wide so a 4K render stays sharp; 9.5 s from 0.5 s. Run page from queued to the last job at 13x, then the finished page 2 s at 1x (no reload). Masked: account name, run number, commit id.
